Model before rewriting:

find x: int(2..5)
find y: int(2..5)

such that

(x ** y) = 4

   ~~> select_representation ([("ReprGeneral", 10000)])

new variables:
  find x#int_order_1: bool
  find x#int_order_2: bool
  find x#int_order_3: bool
  find x#int_order_4: bool
new constraints:
  x#int_order_1
  or([!(x#int_order_2),x#int_order_1;int(1..)])
  or([!(x#int_order_3),x#int_order_2;int(1..)])
  or([!(x#int_order_4),x#int_order_3;int(1..)])
  or([and([SATInt(Order, [x#int_order_1,x#int_order_2,x#int_order_3,x#int_order_4;int(1..)] [2, 5]) >= 2,SATInt(Order, [x#int_order_1,x#int_order_2,x#int_order_3,x#int_order_4;int(1..)] [2, 5]) <= 5;int(1..)]);int(1..)])
